verdict.rationale: smolagents documents sandboxed code execution via Modal, Blaxel, E2B, or Docker to secure execution, which supports isolated testing separate from production systems, though this is framed as security isolation rather than an explicit 'sandbox vs production data' testing workflow. missing for 10: no explicit guidance on separating test/sandbox data from production data stores, no independent verification of sandbox isolation guarantees, no discussion of staging/test environment patterns beyond code execution sandboxing.
